description: Implementation of LoanLockingService for managing loan account locks, including methods for applying, upgrading, and querying locks, with SQL statements for lock management.

classes.name: LoanLockingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing loan lock management, including lock application, upgrade, and retrieval.

methods.name: upgradeLock
methods.description: Increments lock version and updates lock owner for given loan accounts.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdIn
methods.description: Retrieves all lock records for specified loan IDs.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLockOwner
methods.description: Finds a lock record for a specific loan ID and lock owner.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Retrieves all lock records for specified loan IDs and lock owner.

methods.name: applyLock
methods.description: Applies locks to a list of loan IDs with specified lock owner.

methods.name: deleteByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Deletes lock records for specified loan IDs and lock owner.

methods.name: getInClauseParameterSizeLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum size for SQL IN clause parameters from configuration.
